commentary.text: 90+16' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+14' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
90+11' A quickly taken corner by Celta Vigo.
90+10' Celta Vigo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+10' A pass into the penalty area from Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is intercepted by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Celta Vigo.
90+8' Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.

90+4' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
90' 15 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Substitution. Ilias Akhomach is replaced by Ramon Terrats (Villarreal).
88' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Alex Baena will be replaced by Manu Trigueros (Villarreal).
88' Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
86' The game has come to an end for Kevin Vazquez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo).
84' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
82' The foul by Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Cesar Soto Grado.
82' Celta Vigo will take a corner kick.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Franco Cervi departs the field of play to be replaced by Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo).
81' Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Celta Vigo.
81' The ball goes out of play. Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.
78' Filip Jorgensen (Villarreal) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
78' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
77' The attendance is 14687.
77' A yellow card for a tackle by Santi Comesana (Villarreal). Cesar Soto Grado doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
75' Alex Baena (Villarreal) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Cesar Soto Grado lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
74' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 13:9.
72' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
69' Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) was too forceful with his tackle and Cesar Soto Grado interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
69' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
67' A snap shot by Carlos Dotor (Celta Vigo) from distance flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
65' Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
63' The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.

63' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than low towards the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
62' Celta Vigo get a corner.
61' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
60' Substitution. Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) in, Alberto Moreno out.
60' Problems for Marcelino as Raul Albiol is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) replaces him.
59' Raul Albiol (Villarreal) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
57' 3 - 2 Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
52' 3 - 1 Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) has a great chance inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
50' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Villarreal.
48' 3 - 0 Goal! Dani Parejo (Villarreal) puts the ball into the left side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Vicente Guaita.
47' Alex Baena (Villarreal) makes a rough challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Kevin Vazquez (Celta Vigo) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Cesar Soto Grado ignores the protests.

46' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle after Kevin Vazquez (Celta Vigo) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Villarreal.
46' Rafael Benitez has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) comes on the pitch for Luca de la Torre.
46' Half-time substitution. Carl Starfelt will not participate anymore and Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) is coming on.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) comes onto the pitch so that Mihailo Ristic can be given a rest.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The end of the first half.

45+5' Alex Baena (Villarreal) latches on to the corner kick on the edge of the box and releases a quick strike. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way wide of the right post.
45+5' Villarreal force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45+5' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) picks up an injury.
45+3' The free kick from long range, taken by Villarreal, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) commits a foul and Cesar Soto Grado immediately signals a free kick.
43' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Villarreal players have a reason to celebrate!
42' Wait! Referee Cesar Soto Grado has indicated he is going to review the Villarreal goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
41' 2 - 0 Goal 2:0! Aissa Mandi (Villarreal) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
40' Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
38' Celta Vigo win a corner.
34' Villarreal work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

33' Carlos Romero (Villarreal) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Villarreal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
31' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
30' Total attempts – 6:3.
27' The ball is cleared after Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
27' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) receives a clever chip pass into a promising position. Nevertheless, one of the defenders is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
26' The referee blows his whistle as Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) was too aggressive in his challenge.
24' Villarreal hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
22' Alfonso Pedraza is being substituted because of an injury. Marcelino sends Carlos Romero (Villarreal) on the pitch.
20' Adria Altimira (Villarreal) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Cesar Soto Grado no option but to blow his whistle.
16' The free kick is taken by Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo), but ball is cleared.
16' Cesar Soto Grado couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Adria Altimira (Villarreal) and blew his whistle. Celta Vigo have a free kick.

13' 1 - 0 A superb goal from great team play! Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot straight into the roof of the net. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
11' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Vicente Guaita pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.

11' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
9' Adria Altimira (Villarreal) sends a long ball in, but Vicente Guaita comfortably gathers the ball.
8' PENALTY APPEAL by Villarreal, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!

6' A lofted ball into the centre of the box is met with a forceful header by Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal), but it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
5' Aissa Mandi (Villarreal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
4' The corner is swung in but Villarreal can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

4' What a save from Vicente Guaita! Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. It will be a corner kick for Villarreal.
1' The first half has just begun.
Villarreal will kick the game off.
Cesar Soto Grado got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
